title: Ultrasonic Detection Generator
source_docs: Automated Driving Toolbox/Driving Scenario and Sensor Modeling/Ultrasonic_Detection_Generator.md
text: Generate ultrasonic sensor detections from driving scenario or RoadRunner Scenario, 1 input, 1 output, {Width of actors’ cuboids (m)} sets Width of actor cuboids; {Unique identifier of sensor} sets the unique sensor identifier, {Translation [ X, Y, Z ] relative to ego origin (m)} sets the sensor location on ego vehicle, {Rotation [Yaw, Pitch, Roll] relative to ego’s frame (deg)} sets the mounting rotation angles of radar, {Field of view [horizontalFOV, verticalFOV] (deg)} sets the angular field of view of ultrasonic sensor, {Detection ranges [minDetOnlyRange, minDistRange, maxDistRange] (m)} sets the detection range vector of ultrasonic, {Update rate (Hz)} sets the sensor update rate, {Source of output bus name}, {Specify an output bus name} sets the name of output bus, {Target profiles definition} sets the method to specify target profiles, {MATLAB expression for target profiles}, {Unique identifier for actors} sets the scenario-defined actor identifier, {User-defined integer to classify actors} sets the user-defined classification identifier, {Length of actors’ cuboids (m)} sets the length of actor cuboids, {Height of actors’ cuboids (m)} sets the height of actor cuboids and {Rotational center of actors from bottom center (m)} sets the rotational center of actors. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Translation [ X, Y, Z ] relative to ego origin (m)
params.values: Sensor location on ego vehicle (m) [3.4, 0, 0.2] (default) | 1-by-3 real-valued vector of form [ x y z ]

params.name: Rotation [Yaw, Pitch, Roll] relative to ego’s frame (deg)
params.values: Mounting rotation angles of radar [0 0 0] (default) | 1-by-3 real-valued vector of form [ z yaw y pitch x roll ]

params.name: Field of view [horizontalFOV, verticalFOV] (deg)
params.values: Angular field of view of ultrasonic sensor [70 35] (default) | 1-by-2 positive real-valued vector of form [horizontalFOV verticalFOV]

params.name: Detection ranges [minDetOnlyRange, minDistRange, maxDistRange] (m)
params.values: Detection range vector of ultrasonic sensor (m) [0.03 0.15 5.5] (default) | 1-by-3 nonnegative real-valued vector of form [minDetOnlyRange minDistRange maxDistRange]

params.values: Sensor update rate 10 (default) | positive real scalar
